verdict.rationale: Godot is MIT-licensed open source, and users are sole owners of their content. Source assets live as ordinary files directly in the local project folder, with imported copies kept separately in .godot/imported, and scripts can be edited in external text editors, so there is no vendor-held data to extract. However, the evidence never documents that Godot's own scene and resource formats are open or interoperable, nor any export path for migrating a project to other tools. missing for 10: documentation of open/text scene and resource file formats, export or migration tooling for project data to other engines, independent corroboration of portability.
